items.solution:
- Project initialized, knowledge tracking started
- Tau is a fork of alejandro-ao/tau being hardened into a goal-locked agentic harness. Current local slices add Loop2-compatible run receipts plus minimal model-facing contracts for subagent receipts, generated tickets, handoffs, and human-only goal changes. Tau derives GitHub labels deterministically instead of asking model agents to duplicate label/projection fields.

title: Tau persona-dream harness needs panel-repair-gate creator/reviewer loop
state: OPEN

## Type

feature

## Target

/home/graham/workspace/experiments/tau

## Current state

The serial persona-dream pipeline now reaches panel_repair_gate with a valid persona_dream.panel_repair_work_order.v1, but Tau has no ticketed loop that consumes this work order from the current dream/story/storyboard run and writes receipts/panel_repair_gate_receipt.json.

## Requested outcome

Consume the panel repair work order through Tau harness using panel-creator, panel-reviewer, and persona-dream-panel-repair-gate, generating a real Scillm/GPT image panel and canonical persona-dream repair receipts without Kling or paid provider submission.

## Required proof

focused Tau tests plus persona-dream validate-panel-repair-work-order, validate-panel-repair-gate, and pipeline-loop-status artifacts from the issue-41 dream-run root

## Route

unknown

## Requested repair agent

Not specified.

## Non-goals

No unrelated refactors or scope expansion.

## Ticket type details

- **Current limitation:** The serial persona-dream pipeline now reaches panel_repair_gate with a valid persona_dream.panel_repair_work_order.v1, but Tau has no ticketed loop that consumes this work order from the current dream/story/storyboard run and writes receipts/panel_repair_gate_receipt.json.
- **Proposed capability:** Consume the panel repair work order through Tau harness using panel-creator, panel-reviewer, and persona-dream-panel-repair-gate, generating a real Scillm/GPT image panel and canonical persona-dream repair receipts without Kling or paid provider submission.
- **User workflow unlocked:** Start from /home/graham/workspace/experiments/tau/experiments/goal-locked-subagents/proofs/issue-41-persona-dream-dream-packet-loop-20260629T204320Z/dream-run/receipts/panel_repair_work_order.json; run the serial subagent loop; write receipts/panel_repair_gate_receipt.json and referenced generation, script coverage, visual review, no-overlay, and status-transition artifacts; rerun persona-dream validators and pipeline-loop-status --direction forward.
- **Acceptance criteria:** validate-panel-repair-work-order returns PASS_PANEL_REPAIR_WORK_ORDER; Tau consumes persona_dream.panel_repair_work_order.v1; panel image is generated through Scillm/GPT image lane and not Nano Banana/Gemini final imagery; panel-reviewer writes independent visual review receipt; validate-panel-repair-gate reports the first honest blocker or PASS without Kling; pipeline-loop-status --direction forward advances past panel_repair_gate to panel_source_receipt or later; no Kling call, no direct paid provider call, no unreceipted image generation.
